observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale. The east facing is a large painterly animal with branching antlers, a striped cream body and a trunk-like snout, stretched out flat in a swimming or sprawling pose. The south and north facings are tiny flat cartoon icons with heavy black outlines, greyscale with zebra stripes, and look nothing like the east painting. South shows a cartoon face with glossy round eyes, seen nearly from overhead. North looks like a top-down back with stripes, a spine line and ears at the top.
observed.south.png: A small flat cel-shaded icon with a thick black keyline. A grey-and-white striped head seen from the front or above, with round cartoon eyes, small ears or horn nubs and an outline of the body behind. No antlers, no trunk-like snout, no painterly texture. It is in a different style and at a very different scale from east.
observed.east.png: A high-resolution painterly side profile of a heavy, barrel-bodied quadruped lying stretched forward, with its legs extended front and back (a swim or sprawl pose). Cream body with bold dark brown vertical stripes over the back, flanks, rump and tail. Neck and shoulders solid dark brown, lower legs dark brown, belly cream. Two tall branching palmate-tipped antlers rise from the back of the skull. A long down-turned tapir-like snout with a pale muzzle. Broad padded feet with pale claws. The tail is striped and ends in a brown tuft. Fringes of red, yellow and black fringe pixels show along the antler edges and back outline: matting halo artifacts from an imperfect cut-out.
observed.north.png: A small flat cartoon icon seen from directly above: an oval striped grey body with a white spine line, the ears or head at the top and a small tail stub at the bottom, with a light grey halo outline around it. No antlers, no painterly detail. It reads as an overhead view, not the rear from the game camera.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the east painting stretches across about one cell, lying low and long, shorter than the human but longer. At 32 px it reads as a low striped smear with antlers.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South is a tiny flat cartoon icon of a different creature, a nearly overhead head-on view with no antlers or snout. It is not the front of this painted animal.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North is a top-down cartoon of a striped oval back with the ears or head visible at the top. It is not the rear of this animal from the game camera, and it comes from a different art set entirely.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: The north icon is an overhead plan view (spine line down the middle, oval body). South is also strongly overhead.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Measured height spread is 424%: east is 860 px against about 165 px for south and north. That is not a pose difference. South and north are tiny placeholder icons.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: East is a painterly antlered brown and cream striped tapir-like beast. South and north are greyscale cartoon icons with no antlers, no trunk and a different palette and style.

SIGNATURE.seen: On east: branching antlers, a flexible snout, dark stripes on a pale coat and front claws are all clearly legible.

ALIEN.seen: East combines tapir snout, deer antlers, zebra stripes and claws. No single Earth animal would be named at first glance, and all departures are present.

DEPARTURES.seen: East only: 1) a squat, low body on short legs, present; 2) a long trunk-like snout, present; 3) clawed toes with pale claws, no hooves, present; 4) a pale coat with bold dark brown stripes, present. South and north show none of these.

CANON.seen: East meets almost every canon line: barrel body with a shoulder hump and sagging belly, tall branching antlers that are the tallest point, the colour layout, a down-turned snout with a pale muzzle, a tufted tail, pale claws, no nose horn. South and north fail all of the identity lines: no antlers, no snout, grey palette.

STYLE.seen: East is painterly and realistic. South and north are flat cel-shaded sticker icons with heavy black keylines and glossy round cartoon eyes on south.

OURS.seen: East looks like our own generated art. South and north look like script-drawn or stand-in placeholder icons, not final art.

ALPHA.seen: East has visible red, yellow and black matting fringe pixels along the antler edges, the back outline and the belly. North has a light grey halo ring around the body.

SCALE.seen: East at max zoom is a squat animal about a cell long, lower than the human. That fits 'squat forest herbivore', perhaps slightly small for a 'heavy' beast, and this is a juvenile.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px the east view reads as a low striped body with antlers, though it is thin because of the flat sprawl pose.

The rear view is seen from the low three-quarter game camera angle: rounded haunches, striped rump, short tufted tail, hind legs and the backs of the antlers rising above, head hidden behind the shoulders.

The front view shows the runyip's face toward the viewer: long flexible trunk-like snout hanging down the middle of the face, two dark eyes, both branching antlers rising, and the front legs with pale claws on the toes.
The rear view shows only back, striped rump, tail and haunches, with the antlers seen from behind and the eyes, snout and face hidden.
Every facing is in realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld style: soft painted shading, thin clean dark outline, natural matte eyes.
Each facing is new art of this runyip, painted from the description and the departures, not an icon or placeholder.
Every facing shows tall branching antlers, a pale cream coat crossed by bold dark brown stripes, darker brown shoulders, and a squat low-slung body on short legs.
Transparent background with a clean cut-out: antler tines and body edges fade straight to transparency, with only the dark brown outline color at the edge.

squat low-slung body on short legs

request.prompt: A single RimWorld creature sprite, the runyip, a squat forest herbivore from Yavin 4. Body plan: low-slung, stocky body on short legs, clearly not a tall long-legged deer frame. A long flexible trunk-like snout extends from the face. Tall branching antlers rise from the head. The front toes carry pale claws instead of hooves. The coat is pale cream crossed by bold dark brown stripes, with darker brown shoulders; the rump is striped with a short tufted tail. Style: realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld art, soft painted shading, thin clean dark outline, natural matte eyes, seen from the low three-quarter game camera angle. The animal fills the same share of the canvas in every facing, about 80% of the canvas width in side view with matching height and scale in the front and rear views. Facing: [side view, head toward the right / front view, eyes and trunk-like snout toward the viewer, both antlers rising, front legs with pale claws / rear view, seen from behind: striped rump, tufted tail, haunches and hind legs, the antlers seen from behind, head hidden behind the shoulders]. Transparent background with a clean cut-out: antler tines and body edges fade straight to transparency, with only the dark brown outline color at the edge.

subject: RM_Venomvine

reply.subject: RM_Venomvine

observed.single.png: A flat, spread-out tangle of thick, twisting woody runners on transparent alpha. They come from a knotted centre and reach out sideways, the tips curling into hooks. The bark is rust-red and umber with painted texture. Pale bone-tan curved thorns line the runners, mostly on their lower edges. The dark outline is moderate. There is no green, soil or shadow. The mass is about 1100 px wide and 570 px tall, sitting slightly below the canvas centre, with empty space above and below. The curled tips and rows of fang-like thorns give it a slightly tentacle or creature-like feel.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom it is a low, wide, flat tangle beside a vanilla human, filling most of one cell's width and less than half its height: ground-hugging, ankle-high. At normal play (32 px per cell) it is a small brown spiky smudge that still reads as a thorny patch.

SIGNATURE.seen: Thick woody runners sprawling flat, rust-umber with no green, and short recurved bone-tan thorns mostly on the lower edges.

READS_KIND.seen: Low, flat, wide sprawl of separate runners. It reads as a ground thicket, not a blob.

NATURAL.seen: Organic twisting runners with bark texture. Nothing looks made by people.

ANCHOR.seen: A flat ground cover seen from above, not cut off. The mass sits slightly below centre rather than on the bottom edge, which is reasonable for a flat mat.

NO_SCENERY.seen: Real alpha with no soil, ground disc or shadow.

ALIEN.seen: Blood-brown runners with fang-like recurved thorns and hooked tips. This is no familiar Earth plant.

STYLE.seen: Painterly bark texture and shaded thorns. The hooked tips and evenly spaced fang thorns lean a little illustrative and tentacle-like, but it is not cel or toy-like.

OURS.seen: A codex render made for this subject, not vanilla art or art from another mod.

FILLS.seen: Spans about 88% of the canvas width. The 570 px height suits a flat mat.

SCALE.seen: Beside the human it is a low patch about ankle-high, which matches the description.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px per cell it reads as a thorny brown patch, if small.

VARIANTS.seen: Only one picture is provided; there are no variants in the pool.
